data.label: Capture New Lead
data.description: Trigger when a new lead is submitted through the website form.
data.rationale: This is a deterministic event trigger based on form submission. It requires no AI, ML, or language understanding—just a standard webhook/form listener.

data.label: Validate Email Format
data.description: Check whether the submitted email address matches a valid format.
data.rationale: This is pure rule-based validation using regex or equivalent syntax checks. L0 is sufficient because the logic is fully deterministic and does not involve uncertainty or language interpretation.

data.label: Check CRM Duplicates
data.description: Search the CRM for existing records that match the new lead.
data.rationale: This step is a deterministic CRM lookup/match operation. It can be handled with exact or predefined fuzzy-match rules and does not require ML or LLM reasoning unless the matching rules become ambiguous, which is not stated here.

data.label: Score Lead
data.description: Calculate a lead score using company size, industry, and engagement history.
data.rationale: Start at L0: a simple rules engine could score based on fixed thresholds and weighted factors. However, the step explicitly combines multiple features such as company size, industry, and engagement history, which is commonly modeled as a trained scoring function or regression/classification model when variation and weighting need to adapt. That pushes it to L1 rather than L0. No language understanding or generation is required.

data.label: Route to Sales Rep
data.description: Assign high-scoring leads to a sales rep and attach a personalized summary.
data.rationale: Routing the lead assignment itself is deterministic, but the step also requires generating a personalized summary. That introduces genuine language generation, which exceeds L0/L1/L2. A single LLM can draft the summary from the lead data without needing external tools, so L3 is appropriate.

data.label: Add to Nurture Campaign
data.description: Enroll low-scoring leads into the nurture campaign for automated follow-up.
data.rationale: This is a straightforward deterministic workflow action: place the lead into a predefined campaign based on a score threshold. No AI, language understanding, or model inference is needed.

data.label: Flag for Manual Review
data.description: Mark mid-scoring leads for review by the sales team.
data.rationale: This is a deterministic status update or queueing action triggered by a score range. It does not involve AI or any language generation/understanding beyond the conditional threshold check already defined in the workflow.

message: Overall, this workflow is predominantly deterministic automation (L0) with one supervised scoring step (L1) and one LLM-generated personalization step (L3). No multi-agent orchestration is required. The workflow uses standard triggers, validation, CRM lookup, threshold routing, and a single generated summary for sales handoff.

workflow.workflowBrief: When a new lead comes in through the website form, validate the email format and check for duplicates in the CRM. Score the lead based on company size, industry, and engagement history. If the score is above 80, route to a sales rep with a personalized summary. If below 40, add to the nurture campaign. For scores in between, flag for manual review by the sales team.
